facts.value: Maintains the Barrel Cannon's passive grounded phase: it sets xDCC_flag.b3 according to whether the stored fighter reference tarucann.x20 is null and delegates occupancy-sensitive lifetime processing. Its paired collision callback handles support loss and steep-slope activation; the animation callback does not itself activate rolling.

Resolves rendered Fall_Anim collision and covers both empty and occupied active airborne rows 3/6, including upward motion after capture. Does not imply exclusive dispatch from numeric state 6.

evidence.why: Exact threshold, side effects and float return.

facts.rationale: Corrects conflation of callback suffix with numeric dispatch state while retaining the strict threshold and occupancy-dependent destinations.
facts.value: Shared physics callback for table rows 4 and 7. It updates rolling motion and model rotation, then tests abs(tarucann.x10) > attributes.x8. If the test fails it makes no motion-state change, preserving the current row rather than necessarily state 7. If it succeeds, it copies x10 into horizontal velocity, zeros vertical velocity, selects row 8 when occupied or row 5 when empty, performs shared setup and registers fighter entry only when empty. It returns the final absolute x10 as float.

facts.rationale: Makes the nested acceleration/friction split explicit and preserves directional factors omitted by the baseline summary.
facts.value: Selects no motion state. On the ground, if abs(tarucann.x14.x) > 0.1, it adds x14.x * attributes.x10 to rolling speed only while abs(x10) < attributes.x18; at or above that speed threshold it does not apply friction. Friction is exclusive to abs(x14.x) <= 0.1: speed becomes zero below attributes.x14, otherwise that amount is added with opposing sign. It aligns facing with speed, caps speed magnitude using attributes.xC, sets velocity.x = x28 * x10 * x14.y, and adds x28 * 0.12217305 * abs(x10) * -facing_dir to angle xC. In air it instead adds 0.10471976 * -facing_dir * x28 to angle without changing speed or velocity. Both paths finally add attributes.x50 * -facing_dir to angle.

facts.rationale: Uses the canonical named quake kind rather than an unsupported numeric reaction value and includes the occupancy-dependent flag update.
facts.value: Reads the Item and root JObj, synchronizes xDCC_flag.b3 to whether tarucann.x20 is null, then switches on xDAC_itcmd_var0. Command 1 sends the item position to effect 0x427 and Camera_RequestQuake(QuakeKind_Small), requests sound 0xFB with 0x7F/0x40, hides the model hierarchy, calls it_8026B3A8, sets tarucann.x4 to 40 and command to 2. Command 2 decrements x4 and returns true at zero or below; otherwise the callback returns false.
